# Brand typography: no serif

TOCguide branding is **bold sans-serif only**. Never introduce a serif typeface.

## Never use

- Serif families: Fraunces, Newsreader, Georgia, Times, Times New Roman, Palatino, Garamond, or generic `serif`
- Serif fallbacks in any `font-family` stack (do not write `…, Georgia, serif`)
- Decorative italic serif display type on marketing, docs, or admin chrome

## Do use

- Marketing / GitHub Pages (`docs/*.html`): **Outfit** at 600 (body), 700 (UI), 800 (headings). Stack: `Outfit, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif`
- SVG wordmarks and mockups: system UI sans (`-apple-system`, `"Segoe UI"`, `sans-serif`) at 600–800
- Admin chrome (`admin/css/admin.css`): inherit wp-admin sans; brand `h1` at `font-weight: 800`
- Monospace is allowed for code, slugs, and CLI (e.g. `ui-monospace`, `Menlo`)

## Front-end TOC block

Do **not** inject a branded font on the published Table of Contents (`src/style.scss`). The block inherits the theme so it matches the post. Never add a serif (or any custom family) there.

## If you add a new surface

Default to a geometric sans at 600–800. If a design draft uses serif, convert it to sans before shipping.
